message: Verdant 15.4.2 is available through VCC. Update the package, then run the V15.4.2 Supporters + Clock + Version Fix once in Unity.
notes: Protects every vertical ScrollRect in the Supporters/Support board against programmatic snap-to-top refreshes.
Detects actual time-looking labels on the Main Board and iPad, not only objects explicitly named Clock.
Wires detected 12-hour and 24-hour buttons to one shared Verdant clock state.
Runs the scroll guard and shared clock late so older Verdant scripts are less likely to overwrite them.
Restores or creates a small version label on the Main Board.
